events.title: Australia's Least Decorated Soldier
events.details:
https://www.edfringe.com/tickets/whats-on/australia-s-least-decorated-soldier

After travelling to the UK, New Zealand, the Middle East and Indonesia. Jarryd Goundrey is back as Australia's Least Decorated Soldier. Jarryd Goundrey. Comedian and army veteran has amassed 100 million views online with his witty and hilarious storytelling. Come see why he recently sold out the Melbourne International Comedy Festival and has supported some of Australia’s best acts.
